hypothesis: uncertainty-aware scheduling lowers prediction RMSE relative to strong periodic and event/deadline baselines under equal caps
primary_metric: mean per-episode fixed-grid one-second-ahead RMSE; lower is better

scoring.failures: all unsuccessful operation receipts retained; unit exceptions invalidate comparisons

resource_contract.fixed_overhead: clock, scheduling, prior propagation, fixed-grid forecasts, scoring
resource_contract.inference: paid classical measurement update, not an LLM call

limitations: hybrid is an oscillator adaptation using preserved original analytic dynamics
nominal Kalman covariance can be miscalibrated after hidden shifts
same resource caps do not guarantee equal realized consumption
